Job Title: Senior Product Designer
Experience: 5+ years
Location: Fully remote within India.
Mandatory Skills:
- Figma
- User Research
- UI/UX Design

Good to have:
- Adobe XD
- Design Systems
- Adobe Photoshop

Responsibilities:
- Lead end-to-end product design for consumer-facing and internal web and mobile applications, translating product strategy into delightful, usable interfaces.
- Conduct and coordinate qualitative and quantitative user research, usability testing, and customer interviews to validate design decisions and inform product direction.
- Create high-fidelity interactive prototypes and detailed UI assets in Figma; iterate quickly based on stakeholder and user feedback.
- Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and Marketing to define requirements, prioritize features, and ensure designs are implemented to specification.
- Establish and maintain a cohesive Design System to ensure consistency across platforms and accelerate delivery.
- Mentor and review work from junior designers, providing constructive feedback and promoting best practices in UI/UX and user research.
- Participate in sprint planning, design reviews, and cross-functional standups to align on timelines and deliverables.
- Advocate for accessibility, performance, and data-informed design improvements throughout the product lifecycle.

Company context:
We are a fast-growing fintech startup focused on simplifying financial management for small businesses across India. Our small, autonomous product teams move quickly to test ideas and ship features that improve customer experience. As Senior Product Designer, you will have significant ownership over product direction and the opportunity to shape our design culture and systems while working fully remotely within India.
